Giant Strength
The mountains tremble! <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> increases to 23. This effect increases with level.
Guardian Chain
Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistance">resistance</LSTag> to all damage types.
Demigod's Mark
Ignore all damage of 8 points or less from all damage types.
Bone Spike Armor
Reduce all damage taken by 2 points. When hit by melee attacks, the attacker takes 1d6 piercing damage. This effect increases with level. This ability can be toggled on and off.
Reduce all damage taken by [1] points.
When hit by melee attacks, the attacker takes [1]. This effect increases with level. This ability can be toggled on and off.
Deflect Missiles

Gain 2 additional <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction points</LSTag>. Use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to reduce damage from ranged weapon attacks by 1d10 + your Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">modifier</LSTag> + your character level, and cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="LangFeats_Projectile_Deflect_Missiles">Deflect Missiles: Redirect</LSTag> at the attacker.
Gain [1] additional <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction points</LSTag>.

Use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to reduce damage from ranged weapon attacks by 1d10 + your Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">modifier</LSTag> + your character level, and cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="LangFeats_Projectile_Deflect_Missiles">Deflect Missiles: Redirect</LSTag> at the attacker.
Deflect Missiles: Redirect

Use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> ability to catch a projectile from a ranged weapon attack and redirect it back at the attacker, dealing scaling [1] damage.
Extra Attack
After making an unarmed or weapon attack, you can make one additional free attack. Multiple attacks from different classes do not stack.
Aura of Murder
Enemies within 3m range become vulnerable to piercing damage, unless they have resistance or immunity to piercing damage. This ability can be toggled on and off.
Widen Wounds
When you score a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">critical hit</LSTag>, deal an additional 1d6 force damage (Type A additional damage). This effect increases with level.
When you score a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">critical hit</LSTag>, deal an additional [1] force damage (Type A additional damage). This effect increases with level.
Tragic Critical
When you score a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">critical hit</LSTag>, deal an additional 7 damage (Type B additional damage). This feat can be learned multiple times.
Improved Critical

When making <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">attack rolls</LSTag>, the number required to trigger a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">critical hit</LSTag> is reduced by 1. This effect can stack. This feat can be learned multiple times.
Precision Shot
When you roll 10 or lower on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">attack rolls</LSTag> with ranged weapons, you must reroll and use the new result.
Titan Shot
Your ranged weapon attacks deal additional damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">modifier</LSTag>.
Cantrip Master

Cantrips that consume an <LSTag Tooltip="Action">action</LSTag> now consume a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> instead. This ability can be toggled on and off.
Agonizing Blast
Cantrips deal additional damage equal to your chosen ability <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">modifier</LSTag>. The chosen ability score increases by 1.
Agonizing Blast (Strength)
Cantrips deal additional damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">modifier</LSTag>. <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> increases by 1.

Cantrips deal additional damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">modifier</LSTag>. <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> increases by 1.

Cantrips deal additional damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">modifier</LSTag>. <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag> increases by 1.
Agonizing Blast (Intelligence)

Cantrips deal additional damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="Intelligence">Intelligence</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">modifier</LSTag>. <LSTag Tooltip="Intelligence">Intelligence</LSTag> increases by 1.
Agonizing Blast (Wisdom)
Cantrips deal additional damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">modifier</LSTag>. <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag> increases by 1.
Agonizing Blast (Charisma)
